title: Deconvolve (OASIS)
description: Spikes and denoised calcium of each ΔF/F trace by OASIS (Friedrich et al. 2017), natively in both languages, for an AR(2) model of a rise and a decay (dev's default) or an AR(1) model of the decay: c minimises 1/2 |c - y|^2 + lambda * sum(s) with spikes s_t = c_t - g1 c_(t-1) - g2 c_(t-2) >= 0. The decay factor d = exp(-1 / (tauDecay * frameRate)) and the rise factor r = exp(-1 / (tauRise * frameRate)) give g1 = d + r and g2 = -d r, as dev's exp2ar (AR(1): g1 = d, g2 = 0); before the first spike the calcium decays by d. lambda is sparsity times the trace's noise, median(|diff(y)|) / (0.6745 * sqrt(2)). AR(1) reaches the exact optimum; AR(2), as OASIS does, fits each pool of frames with those before it fixed, which comes close to it.
